sources.title: Extraction of aromatic and polyaromatic compounds with NMP: experimental and model description
sources.note: All equilibrium experiments were performed at 298.15 K. Heating at 50-70 C was sample preparation to dissolve pyrene, not an equilibrium-temperature series.

sources.title: Extraction of pentylbenzene from high molar mass alkanes (C14 and C17) by N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone
sources.note: Provides temperature dependence for a monoaromatic, not a diaromatic or polyaromatic.

sources.title: Extraction of Aromatics from Middle Distillate Using N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone: Experiment, Modeling, and Optimization
sources.evidenceType: multicomponent aromatic extraction and phase equilibrium
sources.note: All listed aromatic solutes are monoaromatics; this cannot identify heavy-aromatic temperature response.

admissionRule: A heavy-aromatic temperature model requires direct NMP equilibrium or partition evidence for DI or POLY at two or more equilibrium temperatures. Sample-preparation temperature, monoaromatic temperature data, solubility-only data, and another solvent do not qualify.

requiredMeasurements: phase amounts or independently closed total material balance
requiredExperiment.qualification: Predeclare molecule/system and temperature holdouts; require topology recall >=0.90, tie-line RMSD <=0.03, conservation, isoactivity, stability, ambiguity rejection, and independent final-phase checks.
